title: Affine pullback of a perfect generator
statement: Let g:X'\to X be an affine morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let M be a perfect generator of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-generators, lem-pc-perfect-generator-exists]. Then Lg^*M is a generator of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X') [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-generators].

source.place: Tag 0BQT (perfect-remark-pullback-generator), affine pullback of a perfect generator

proof.text: Derived pullback preserves quasi-coherent cohomology by the stated tensor/pullback preservation lemma. The chosen derived pullback has a derived adjunction with derived direct image by nonempty_derivedPullbackAdjunction. The finite affine derived equivalence provides an object of D_QCoh(X) isomorphic to Rg_*E, so transport quasi-coherence along the induced cohomology isomorphisms.

For an object E whose shifted Hom groups from the pulled-back M are all subsingletons, the adjunction and the commutation of derived pullback with shifts identify each corresponding Hom group from M to Rg_*E as subsingleton. The generator criterion hgen therefore gives Rg_*E is zero. The required shift compatibility is extracted from the chosen derived-pullback construction exists_derivedPullback.

Affine derived pushforward reflects isomorphisms by the affine conservativity lemma. Applying this to the zero endomorphism of E shows the identity of E is zero, hence E is zero. The converse follows from uniqueness of morphisms to a zero object.
